title: ggsegBrainnetome 2.0.6
text: subcortical atlas now renders grey-brain anatomical context. MNI152 parcels registered fsaverage5 aseg surrounding cortex, white matter, cerebellum brainstem drawn grey context, coloured parcels sit inside recognisable brain silhouette — matching FreeSurfer subcortical atlases. Regenerating requires FreeSurfer 7.4.1.

title: ggsegBrainnetome 2.0.5
text: Rebuilt subcortical atlas 2D geometry per-atlas projection tuning: bounding-box-derived slabs (3 coronal + 4 axial) structure dilation, 36 fine subcortical parcels render coherent filled shapes instead scattered slivers. 3D meshes unchanged.

title: ggsegBrainnetome 2.0.4
text: Atlas 2D geometry migrated sf-optional brain_polygons format (ggseg.formats 0.0.3). atlases now render without sf GDAL/GEOS/PROJ system libraries, enabling wasm air-gapped installs. Plots unchanged.

title: ggsegBrainnetome 2.0.0
text: brainnetome now ggseg_atlas object (ggseg.formats) containing 2D polygon geometry. Atlas recreated scratch using ggsegExtra::create_cortical_atlas() BN_Atlas annotation fsaverage5. Use ggplot() + ggseg::geom_brain(atlas = brainnetome) 2D plots. ggseg.formats now hard dependency (Depends). Package URLs updated LCBC-UiO ggseg GitHub organisation.
